eval.description: Anthropic controlled uplift trial: human participants draft an end-to-end biological-weapons acquisition plan with internet only (control) or with a safeguards-removed Claude. External graders (Deloitte) score plans with a pathway rubric. Cards report average scores, uplift factors, and critical failures. Participant pools have included Anthropic staff and contractors such as SepalAI and Mercor.
eval.summary: Measures whether the model helps people plan the acquisition of biological weapons better than the internet alone.
